change: Allocation-free persistent raw PDM serializer/packer; target PCM conversion explicitly unavailable, never substituted

implemented_contract.state: Separate TX/RX Esp32s3I2sPdmRawState: eight uint16 words, eight bit counts, ready/enabled masks and port. Constant bounded storage, no heap or process-global sample history.
implemented_contract.clock: Raw PDM CLK is the WS matrix signal; internal BCK is twice raw sample_rate_hz in locked TX/RX driver. Invoke TX helper on falling BCK after WS update, RX helper on rising BCK with sampled WS. Each codec channel advances one bit per full WS period.
implemented_contract.packing: Consecutive little-endian 16-bit DMA units; BIG_ENDIAN swaps the two bytes of a unit. BIT_ORDER=0 sends/receives MSB first, BIT_ORDER=1 LSB first. Stereo first/second temporal halves map left/right according to WS_IDLE_POL. No frame history is lost between edge calls or DMA descriptors.
implemented_contract.tx: Codec channel modes 0..4 follow TRM Table28.9-4 with actual SINGLE_DATA. Mono consumes one DMA unit; FIRST_VALID selects its temporal half. I2S0 single-DAC mono duplicates each serial bit over WS halves; dual-DAC stereo DOUT=right and DOUT2=left. Helpers reject buffer overwrite while frame is busy and leave output pointers untouched on EMPTY or undocumented conversion.
implemented_contract.rx: Channel2*line is left, channel2*line+1 right; active RX_TDM_CTRL bits0..7 gate capture. Full frames pop ascending channel order. Missing powered electrical inputs return MISSING_SOURCE atomically, never zero-fill. Parent supplies validity solely from powered, registered native electrical sources. RX_MONO additionally gates first/second temporal halves; IDF PDM HAL normally clears RX_MONO and selects channels with RX_TDM_CTRL.
implemented_contract.raw_requirements: PDM_EN=1,TDM_EN=0,PCM_BYPASS=1,HAL-compatible HALF_SAMPLE_BITS=15; RX_BITS_MOD=15; TX_BITS_MOD=15 or IDF stereo32 setting31. Format/mask changes require reset, electrical timing and FIFO/GDMA belong to controller.
implemented_contract.qualification: Vendor guide defines dual-DAC mono only as selecting even numbered supplied units without documenting raw-register DMA consumption across mono FIRST_VALID/channel-mode combinations; single-DAC stereo has no table row. Those configurations return MAPPING_UNDOCUMENTED rather than inventing routing. No converter output, reset seed, constant-input PCM value, or silence/echo fallback is fabricated. Hardware SINGLE_DATA itself is an explicit documented TX channel selection, not a source fallback.

converter_known_properties: I2S0 only; PCM output/input units are16bits.
TX register exposes HP,LP,SINC,sigma-delta shifts with encoded scale0=divide2,1=multiply1,2=multiply2,3=multiply4.
TX IIR HP stage1 fourth parameter=504+MULT12_0; stage2 fourth parameter=504+MULT12_5. Neither the other coefficients nor recurrence/denominator/precision is given.
Locked HAL uses21 cutoff-frequency pairs, chooses nearest absolute difference with earliest entry winning ties. Default35.5Hz maps(6,7). This lookup is not a filter algorithm.
TX LL documents Fpdm=64*Fpcm*fp/fs; locked driver computes OSR=floor(fp/fs), programs SINC_OSR2 and BCK=Fpcm*64*OSR. These clock settings do not determine the sigma-delta output bits.
RX DSR bit0=64,bit1=128 per locked struct/LL and register description. TRM prose erroneously states DSR=bit*64, which would be zero at reset; do not use that prose formula.
Default register reset values and HAL dither flags are software-visible configurations, not internal filter/PRNG reset state.
